GEN-IDENTITY.contract: Scient Agent and a stock omp never read, write, steer or stand in for each other: state folders, variables, pipes and socket folders carry Scient's names, and so do the executable, process, log, sign-in helper and service names and the browser relay's port. Regenerated at every alignment.

GEN-WORDING.contract: The agent calls itself Scient Agent wherever a person or a model reads its words, prompts and the Python client's README included. Regenerated at every alignment.

SA-RELEASE.contract: Only Scient's own workflow builds, signs and drafts releases; Oh My Pi's publishing and repository automation is removed, and so is its Nix packaging, which installs and configures a stock omp.

SA-PRODUCT.contract: Scient Agent reports its own release: scient.json names the product, its version and the exact Oh My Pi release; --version, the startup screen, completions and the User-Agent report the version, and --runtime-info reports all of it with the build id Scient's workflow stamps.

SA-ROOT.contract: State lives under Scient Agent's config root; a host-assigned root (SCIENT_AGENT_ROOT, from the launch environment only) is authoritative, also for user config, natives, global daemons, session owners, crash logs and .env files outside it; browser state follows the active root; a sign-in helper never takes over one Oh My Pi registered.

SA-NATIVE-CACHE.contract: A compiled binary extracts its addons into a folder named for their content and loads only from that folder, falling back from the modern addon to the same build's baseline one; under a host-assigned root the natives folder is the root's.

SA-SERVICES.contract: Oh My Pi's self-updater, startup update check, startup marketplace refresh and automatic issue reports stay off; a host or installer replaces the executable.

SA-RPC-START.contract: Over RPC the agent starts without a model; a host signs in and picks one afterwards. An explicit unresolvable --model still ends the run.

SA-AUTH.contract: A host sees each sign-in's kind, whether it is stored and the store it shares; sign-out over RPC removes it or fails; a broker's sign-ins stay with the broker; a sign-in completed in another process reaches a running session.

SA-WORKER.contract: Shared workers (tiny model, embedding server) carry the product version, so a new Scient Agent release never reuses an earlier release's worker.

SA-BRAND.contract: Pages a person sees (the sign-in result page, the stats dashboard) carry Scient Agent's symbol and colors.

SA-POLICY.contract: An agent working here reads SCIENT.md first, and its rule on keeping Scient's changes apart comes before Oh My Pi's guidance; Scient accepts AI-assisted pull request descriptions, and the contributor stays responsible for them.

SA-BUILD.contract: Scient builds the native addon with cargo on the pinned toolchain: stable expressions where Oh My Pi's Bazel build allows unstable ones.

SA-RPC-SPOOL.contract: The RPC output spool, where frames wait while a host is not reading, stops the agent once it passes 2 GiB (PI_RPC_SPOOL_MAX_BYTES) instead of filling the disk, and its folder names the owning process, so an agent that starts removes the spools of agents that were killed. Proposed to Oh My Pi as can1357/oh-my-pi#16139.
